translation.example:
import numpy as np
from ordinal import clm2_control

c = clm2_control()
print(np.array([
    ["ucminf", "Newton", "nlminb", "optim", "model.frame"].index(c["method"]) + 1,
    c["convTol"], c["ctrl"]["trace"], c["ctrl"]["grtol"],
], dtype=float))
